_note: max_obs_age_s is 0.12 because joint_states from the simulator arrive through ROS-TCP-Endpoint in bursts about every 100 ms (measured 2026-09-16: p50 gap 0.3 ms, p95 100 ms). A 50 Hz policy therefore sees observations up to ~100 ms old; the training side must model that delay or the transport must be fixed.
